scope: Read-only diagnosis of Autodesk ReCap 24.0.0.240 exiting before opening a project.

desktop_connector_messages: Failed to get root folder item of connected drive
Failed to get drive root path

root_cause_assessment.most_likely: Autodesk Identity Manager is missing; ReCap's Identity SDK logs error 3005 and startup terminates before a window appears.
root_cause_assessment.basis: The local Identity Manager install path and uninstall entry are absent; ReCap logs error 3005; Autodesk's current support article defines 3005 as a missing, damaged, or unloadable sign-in component and directs users to install the latest Identity Manager.
root_cause_assessment.not_yet_tested: Whether installing Identity Manager 1.21.1 resolves the ReCap launch on this machine.
